comment: RFC 3339 Appendix A defines the ABNF grammar for ISO-8601 durations used by JSON Schema format 'duration'. These tests enforce only the syntax defined by that grammar.

tests.description: no date or time elements present
weeks cannot be combined with other units
fractional duration is not allowed by RFC 3339 ABNF
tests.comment: numeric components use 1*DIGIT where DIGIT = %x30-39; '.' is not allowed

tests.description: years and days cannot appear without months
hours and seconds cannot appear without minutes
